clauses.clause: Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures, if two or more of those creatures are attacking you and/or planeswalkers you control, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: The only attack in the trace is one opposing creature ([on the opponent's turn, opp_bear attacks you (no block)]: none): the intervening 'if' is never true, so the draw is never shown. The tree reads right (DeclareAttackersEvent over opponent creatures, attacked = you or planeswalkers you control, once_per_event, ATTACK_AGAINST_COUNT_GE 2 with the same filter, draw 1 for you). Packs E01_1..E01_6 show it: three attackers draw exactly one card (E01_1); one of two attacking draws none (E01_2); one at me plus one at my planeswalker, and two at my planeswalker, draw (E01_3, E01_4); with three players, attackers at another player or at another player's planeswalker do not draw for Mangara's controller (E01_5, E01_6). G3 note: one critical survivor remains, 'controller YOU->OPPONENT at event/attacked/children/0/children/0/who' (the first arm of the EVENT's attacked filter read as 'planeswalkers an opponent controls'). It is equivalent: the condition's inner filter is the same expression, so it needs two attackers at 'you or a planeswalker you control' for the trigger to fire at all, and then the real event matched too; the bare arm 'controller is you' already matches a planeswalker I control, so the flip only adds opponents' planeswalkers to a slot the condition gates. Its twin on the condition is killed by pack E01_12.

clauses.clause: Whenever an opponent casts their second spell each turn, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: No stimulus has the opponent cast a spell ([on the opponent's turn, you cast an instant (Life Goes On)] is my own spell: none), so neither the ordinal nor the draw is shown. The tree reads right (CastSpellEvent, actor opponent, ordinal 2, draw 1 for you). Packs E01_7..E01_11: one spell draws none (E01_7), two draw one (E01_8), three draw one (E01_9), my own second spell and a first spell in each of two turns draw none (E01_10), two opponents' first spells draw none (E01_11).
